title: Sony BRAVIA 4K VH21 (KD-65X85K, 2022, device BRAVIA_VH21, MediaTek MT5895), Australia
header:
Sony BRAVIA 4K VH21 (KD-65X85K, 2022, device BRAVIA_VH21, MediaTek MT5895), Australia
Android 12 (Google TV, API 31), build BRAVIA_VH21_M_PA-user 12 STT2.230505.001.S136 682241, 3 GB RAM

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/sony-bravia-4k-vh21/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/sony-bravia-4k-vh21/debloat.txt com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Stock launcher: com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx (Google TV). Pass it to restore.sh as above;
build-and-install disables it, so it is not in this list.
Live TV / tuner app: com.sony.dtv.tvx (set it as live_tv_package in the launcher's config.xml and hide it).
Keep the com.sony.dtv.tvinput.* services, com.sony.dtv.braviasync*, tvapi, sonysystemservice, imeproxy,
settingsprovider, systemupdate/update, the Sony settings apps and all com.mediatek.*: they drive HDMI,
the tuner, Bravia Sync, updates and the remote.
Kept by owner's choice: Chromecast built-in (mediashell), AirPlay/HomeKit (airplayapp, homekit),
firmware updates, HbbTV / Freeview Plus (interactivetvutil), DLNA, Sony IP control (webapi.core).
Already disabled at the factory: com.sonypicturescore, com.sony.dtv.b2b.vendorprotocol,
com.sony.dtv.b2b.softap, com.sony.dtv.kenhchonloc. Not in this list, so restore.sh leaves them alone.

Launcher: the launcher must target SDK 30+ (it does now) or Play Protect blocks the install on this
firmware as "built for an older version of Android". Inputs lists the PS5 on HDMI 1 twice (the port and
its CEC device input) on this firmware.
Speed: memory was the bottleneck (swap full, ~480 MB available with the streaming apps open). The last
group below frees ~120 MB of always-running services; window/transition/animator scales set to 0.5 and
`pm trim-caches` (/data went from 81% to 65% full) helped too. Reboot-checked; Ethernet, so setupwraith
owned no saved Wi-Fi network here (check with `dumpsys wifi` before disabling it on Wi-Fi).
Applied 19-20 Oct 2026; not yet lived with for weeks. If something breaks, `pm enable <package>`
and please report it.
